title: PM Shares Sanskrit Subhashitam; Highlights the Synergy of Talent and Hard Work in Innovation
content:
Press Release:Press Information Bureau Prime Minister's Office PM Shares Sanskrit Subhashitam; Highlights the Synergy of Talent and Hard Work in Innovation Posted On:
                24 FEB 2026 9:37AM by PIB Delhi The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi, has shared a Sanskrit Subhashitam today, emphasizing that success in innovation is a result of both talent and persistent effort. The Prime Minister underscored the timeless wisdom that individual capability must be met with action to achieve results. The message shared by the Prime Minister reads: यथैकेन न हस्तेन तालिका सम्प्रपद्यते। तथोग्यमपरित्यक्तं न फलं कर्मण: स्मृतम्।। "Just as a clap cannot be made with one hand, success in innovation is not possible without effort. Talent bears fruit only when it is supported by hard work and continuous action." The Prime Minister wrote on X; यथैकेन न हस्तेन तालिका सम्प्रपद्यते। तथोद्यमपरित्यक्तं न फलं कर्मणः स्मृतम्॥ यथैकेन न हस्तेन तालिका सम्प्रपद्यते। तथोद्यमपरित्यक्तं न फलं कर्मणः स्मृतम्॥ pic.twitter.com/0twbUYXXqZ — Narendra Modi (@narendramodi) February 24, 2026 *** MJPS/VJ/PKK (Release ID: 2231974) Visitor Counter : 66 Read this release in: Gujarati , Malayalam Prime Minister's Office PM Shares Sanskrit Subhashitam; Highlights the Synergy of Talent and Hard Work in Innovation Posted On:

title: Prime Minister pays tributes to former CM of Tamil Nadu, J. Jayalalithaa ji
content:
Press Release:Press Information Bureau Prime Minister's Office Prime Minister pays tributes to former CM of Tamil Nadu,  J. Jayalalithaa ji Posted On:
                24 FEB 2026 9:33AM by PIB Delhi The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi, paid rich tributes to the former Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu, J. Jayalalithaa ji, on the occasion of her birth anniversary, today.  The  Prime Minister remembered her as a charismatic leader and an outstanding administrator who earned a permanent place in the hearts and minds. Shri Modi highlighted her transformative tenure as the Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu, where she championed welfare-driven governance with a steadfast focus on women empowerment, social justice, and inclusive development. The Prime Minister recalled his interactions with her with great joy. Shri Modi shared specific reflections he had made regarding her life and work during this month’s Mann Ki Baat programme. The Prime Minister  wrote on X: "Remembering Jayalalithaa Ji on her birth anniversary..She has made a place in the hearts and minds of countless people as a charismatic leader and outstanding administrator. Her life journey was one of immense grit and determination. As the Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu, she championed welfare-driven governance with a strong focus on women empowerment, social justice and inclusive development. She was both compassionate and decisive. I recall with great joy my interactions with her. Here is what I had said about her in this month’s #MannKiBaat programme." Remembering Jayalalithaa Ji on her birth anniversary. She has made a place in the hearts and minds of countless people as a charismatic leader and outstanding administrator. Her life journey was one of immense grit and determination.
